title: Tecnomar 55 EVO
description:
The 2019 Tecnomar 55 EVO is a sleek, sporty day cruiser, meticulously maintained and perfect for day trips or weekend escapes. Twin Volvo IPS950 engines give a 38-knot top speed and a 25–30-knot cruise, with fewer than 200 hours as of December 2024.

She features a sophisticated lower-deck lounge instead of cabins, air conditioning, a 13 kW Kohler generator and two large sunbathing areas. Available for immediate purchase in Hong Kong.
